responsibility: This module implements the Rust front end’s lexical analysis subsystem: it reads Rust source from files or in-memory buffers, decodes UTF-8 into a normalized codepoint stream, tracks source locations, and turns that input into the token vocabulary consumed by parsing. Its main file groups cover the core lexer interface and tokenization engine (`rust-lex.*`), reusable input decoding and source wrappers for files and buffers (`rust-input-source.h`), a shared Unicode/codepoint representation used while scanning characters and escapes (`rust-codepoint.h`), and the token model plus token-name and payload helpers that define Rust punctuation, keywords, literals, doc comments, lifetimes, and suffix/type-hint handling (`rust-token.*`). Together these pieces are responsible for enforcing Rust lexical rules, handling raw/byte/string and numeric literal forms, managing lexer lookahead and token splitting needed by syntax such as nested generics, and issuing diagnostics for malformed source at the lexer/parser boundary.
